Strong multimodal embeddings use explicit embedding/contrastive training, strengthening the raw-feature calibration counterhypothesis.
Generative VLMs can become strong embedding models after contrastive adaptation; raw generative features remain an unproven open-set metric.

source_policy: Primary/official implementation and research evidence used for material claims; issue reports are failure evidence, not universal proof.
high_level_result: Current evidence supports a zero-copy Qwen-feature reuse experiment but increases the burden on open-set calibration and recovery testing; no architecture promotion is justified yet.
